headline: Team Europe wins 2026 Laver Cup: Alcaraz seals 13-11 victory on Championship Sunday
whyCareReason: Carlos Alcaraz clinches the 2026 Laver Cup for Team Europe at The O2, defeating Taylor Fritz in the decisive match for a dramatic 13-11 triumph.
teaser: FINAL: Team Europe 13, Team World 11. Alcaraz overcomes Fritz 6-2, 7-5 in the decider as Team Europe hoists the trophy at The O2.
story:
Why this one matters: The 9th edition of the Laver Cup concluded in heart-stopping fashion at London's O2 Arena on Sunday night as Team Europe defeated Team World 13-11 to reclaim the trophy.

Entering Championship Sunday with matches worth three points apiece, Europe launched their comeback in doubles as Carlos Alcaraz and Alexander Zverev defeated Taylor Fritz and Alex de Minaur 6-3, 6-4. Team World answered immediately when De Minaur outdueled Casper Ruud in straight sets.

Alexander Zverev steadied the ship for Europe with a clutch 6-4, 7-6 victory over Brandon Nakashima, setting up a winner-take-all 12th match between Carlos Alcaraz and Taylor Fritz. Before a raucous crowd of 18,000, Alcaraz delivered masterclass tennis, breaking Fritz four times to take a 6-2, 7-5 victory and hand Captain Yannick Noah the championship.
stakes: Team Europe claims the 2026 Laver Cup trophy, ending Team World's recent streak in front of 18,000 fans in London.
rivalryAngle: Europe re-establishes dominance over Team World with Alcaraz providing the decisive championship dagger.
